But that outcome would have blocked the toggle UI, the Seats rendering, the Playwright journey and the docs sweep along with it, stranding landed browser work behind a vendor quota. implementationPlan.description: BRANCH B - THE QUOTA ANSWERS. Bring up the live lane. Run the two processes directly instead, exactly as the recipe in `mem:task-task-2723a9b400984ab7b1b10f97c3523c81-handoff` records: `node --experimental-transform-types apps/daemon/src/daemon-main.ts --dependencies=<abs>/apps/daemon/src/daemon-store-dependencies.ts --asset-root=<abs>/apps/control-room/dist --operator-stdin` (daemon-main.ts:220-222 honours `--operator-stdin` on a PIPE; feed the pairing label with `tail -f <file> | node ... daemon-main.ts` and append the label to that file), plus `node --experimental-transform-types apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/agent-wrapper-main.ts`. They share only the SQLite store; the wrapper starts its own MCP server and needs no daemon origin. USE A FRESH STORE, NOT THE LIVE ONE: an already-seeded store refuses the second bootstrap at `project.activate` with `BOOTSTRAP_COMMAND_BYTES_CONFLICT`. Seed with `node apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/demo-seed-main.ts` and OMIT `MOE_SEED_STOP_BEFORE_APPROVAL` so the drive passes approval and a node actually reaches READY - a seat cannot deliver a node that never became claimable.
